verdict.rationale: The CLI can run entire collections of requests/tests in one command and generate reports, and the MCP server exposes collections, requests, environments, and teams for an agent to read and modify — both enable acting on many items at once. However, there is no explicit documentation of bulk edit/delete/update operations (e.g., multi-select changes across requests) beyond running/reading collections. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-delete API or docs, evidence of an agent performing batch modifications across many items, independent confirmation of scale/performance for large bulk runs.
